items.finding: Scalar global, wrinkling, scarf and thermal screens do not qualify a complete sandwich sphere.
items.evidence_needed: Tests/validated nonlinear analysis for the resized hull, joints, defects and coupled loads.

items.finding: Be endpoint and handbook tensile-yield/elastic values are transferred to thin-sheet compression; endpoint properties need not coexist in one product.
items.evidence_needed: Traceable compressive allowable and thermal properties for the proposed sheet and fabrication process.

items.finding: A lower-density face preserving all Be mechanics and thermal constants is synthetic; elemental Be cannot simply change density.
items.evidence_needed: A specific replacement material demonstrating the combined in-plane properties, compression, joining and thermal compatibility.

items.finding: R20/R30 use 040 temperatures with 048 finish mass; the later cure term changes global demand and hence the near-zero TRL7 result.
items.evidence_needed: Recomputed thermal/residual stress field for the exact large-R coating, geometry and cure history.

items.finding: 047 has a conditional R10 dimple result, not an invertible gamma-to-tolerance law at resized R12/R20/R30.
items.evidence_needed: Imperfection sweeps with calibrated core in-plane law and measured seams for each target geometry.

items.finding: Core specific-shear improvement is represented by G rising at fixed density/strength; thermal mismatch shear rises with sqrt(G).
items.evidence_needed: A complete alternate-core row including G, Ec, in-plane stiffness, conductivity, CTE, shear strength and bond behavior.

items.finding: Reduced bond, finish, film and node masses retain structural, optical and barrier functions by assumption.
items.evidence_needed: Fabricated areal masses with function demonstrated at scale; minimum practical gauges and joint features.

items.finding: 15/30/20 plus separate battery growth is an inherited mixed-maturity scenario; many allocations and a system-level margin are excluded.
items.evidence_needed: Component-specific maturity evidence and a declared complete reserve policy; no TRL7 certification is asserted.

items.finding: 057/CHECK-057 used 6% TRL7 hardware; primary Table VI-1 has 5%, with 6% in the adjacent battery column.
items.evidence_needed: Independent confirmation of the table image and revised class arithmetic; no additional action is assigned by this report.

items.finding: Actual joining and the retained 5% structure floor produce different targets; 058 preserves that floor.
items.evidence_needed: A consistent declared joining reserve policy supported by a fabricated process mass account.

items.finding: The combined factor product is the best feasible multistart result in a bounded scalar model, not a certified global optimum.
items.evidence_needed: Independent search/analytic bounds if a global-minimum claim is needed; all seeds, bounds and witnesses are retained.

items.finding: P3 retains the calibrated constant-g/R f5-019 family. Its no-finite-factor result does not cover alternate topology, g/R or local-shell models.
items.evidence_needed: A new structural solution for tube geometry/topology and local buckling, including section-dependent node/joint and membrane costs.

items.finding: The nominal 3.9 GPa SiC compression value is not a qualified whole-member allowable; about 1.055 GPa is required in the inherited family.
items.evidence_needed: Full tube/member compression and imperfection data for the actual length, wall, ends and temperature.

items.finding: 5.8 GPa ply strength and ten-year retention transfer material/fibre assumptions to a stressed membrane system; perfect retention is only an upper bound.
items.evidence_needed: Biaxial membrane, seam, creep, humidity and aging data for the actual laminate.

items.finding: The SIOX WVTR, 3A net capacity, release kinetics, bed conductance and capture hardware remain unqualified; R20/R30 extend the source beyond R15.
items.evidence_needed: Seven-day pressure/humidity capture experiment over the specified temperature range with full hardware and leakage mass.

items.finding: 058's 100 m floor/full-range history differs from 057's reference; a smaller pressure load requires air, altitude or ballast actions.
items.evidence_needed: One coupled pressure/altitude/temperature/air-mass/service trajectory. Repriced hulls here omit nonnegative debits only as upper bounds.

items.finding: The favorable fixed 058 trim hull raises the R12 optimistic payload upper bound by 58.3 kg but still leaves a 1,036.1 kg deficit before air/bladder costs.
items.evidence_needed: A coherent operational account before this conditional benefit can be credited; it is not an adopted material-closure result.

items.finding: 017b historical routes and baselines differ. A film-strength trend cannot overcome the new tube floor, and Be's trend is flat/nonpositive.
items.evidence_needed: A positive, comparable demonstrated trend for the actually binding material/system property before forecasting a finite closing year.

items.finding: 430 t is estimated 2025 world mined Be content, not rolled-sheet availability; face demand excludes scrap and manufacturing yield.
items.evidence_needed: Current producer capacity, qualified sheet gauge/size and fabrication-yield data for a procurement assessment.

items.finding: Mass growth is applied as a buoyancy account; additional local gravity, attachment and dynamic loads from the grown mass are not recomputed.
items.evidence_needed: Coupled structural loads and deformation for the fully grown mass distribution.
